description: Source code for configuration management in a Linux kernel build system, including functions for parsing, prompting, and setting configuration options.

methods.name: print_help
methods.description: Prints extended help for a menu item.

methods.name: strip
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: xfgets
methods.description: Reads a line from a file, with error handling.

methods.name: set_randconfig_seed
methods.description: Initializes random seed based on environment or current time.

methods.name: randomize_choice_values
methods.description: Randomly sets a choice symbol's value to one of its options.

methods.name: conf_set_all_new_symbols
methods.description: Sets all symbols to a specified default mode.

methods.name: conf_rewrite_tristates
methods.description: Rewrites tristate values from old to new.

methods.name: conf_askvalue
methods.description: Prompts user for a value of a symbol.

methods.name: conf
methods.description: Main recursive function to process configuration menus.

methods.name: check_conf
methods.description: Checks and restarts configuration if needed.

methods.name: conf_usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the configuration tool.
